name: Luxury Hotel Suite
description: An upscale hotel suite with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the city. Elegant modern decor with a king-size bed, ambient lighting, and complete privacy. Makina reserved this room specifically for your 'special reward'.

spots.name: Suite Room
spots.description: A spacious luxury hotel suite with sophisticated decor. A large king-size bed dominates the room, with soft lighting and a stunning city view through panoramic windows. The atmosphere is intimate yet commanding, befitting Makina's style.
